references.text: Mentions Caphtor as the place of origin for the Philistines, linking to the Caphtorim mentioned in Deuteronomy 2:23
The prophecy against the Philistines mentions Caphtor as their place of origin, confirming the connection to the Caphtorim
Amos notes that God brought the Philistines from Caphtor, confirming the migration of the Caphtorim described in this text
Describes the Philistine territory from Shihor near Egypt to Ekron, including Gaza, as mentioned in Deuteronomy 2:23
Mentions Abimelech, king of the Philistines in Gerar, showing the presence of the Philistines in the area around Gaza
